unit.title: Engineering a Bounded Byte Stream in C++
unit.scope: One self-contained software-engineering study unit; it is not a reconstruction of a Stanford assignment.
prerequisites: Comfort with asymptotic analysis and invariants
Working knowledge of C++ value types, RAII, and standard containers
Ability to compile and test a small CMake project
learning_objectives: Turn a behavioral contract into explicit representation invariants
Implement capacity, lifecycle, and accounting rules without losing byte order
Choose a representation that meets stated complexity requirements
Build deterministic boundary, state-transition, and model-based tests
Record reproducible build and test evidence

course_completion.reason: This artifact set covers only a bounded first unit; the remaining course has not been expanded, retrieved, or validated.
course_completion.future_requirement: Later authorized jobs must classify and expand additional units, verify their materials, and validate their evidence independently.
